routes.label: a lost or damaged passport: the application fee and the M300.00 penalty

note: The Ministry of Home Affairs' fees under the Lesotho Passports and Travel Documents (Fees) Regulations, 2019: M130.00 for the regular 32-page passport and M300.00 for 64 pages (the Ministry's FAQ gives M250.00 for 64 pages; the passports page, which names the regulations, is followed). An emergency application adds M500.00, as the FAQ's M630.00 total shows. Replacing a lost or damaged passport adds a M300.00 penalty (M430.00 for 32 pages, as the FAQ sums it; M600.00 for 64 pages by the same sum), written as a replacement route. Validity and processing times are leads.
